# Copilot instructions for MRI Viewer

When reviewing changes below `visionos/`, follow
`.github/instructions/visionos.instructions.md` and
`visionos/REVIEW_RULES.md`.

- Review only changed lines and the surrounding code needed to prove impact.
- Report only concrete, actionable defects introduced or exposed by the pull
  request.
- Do not report praise, summaries, speculative concerns, or style-only
  preferences.
- Do not suggest weakening tests, suppressing compiler diagnostics, exposing
  secrets, or committing patient data.
